name: @pipeworx/mcp-forager

tools.name: forager_find_phone
tools.description: Find a person's phone number from their LinkedIn profile URL, via Forager. Requires both your Forager account id and API key. Example: forager_find_phone({ linkedin_url: "https://www.linkedin.com/in/patrickcollison/", _accountId: "your-forager-account-id", _apiKey: "your-forager-key" })

person_id.description: Optional Forager person id, if already known from a prior Forager lookup, used instead of linkedin_url.

_accountId.description: Your Forager account id (shown alongside your API key on the Forager dashboard).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-forager forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the forager pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
